==Description==
The '''Knight''' was an [[Enemies|enemy]] that appeared in [[The Heights]] during the [[SFOTH Event]]. It was the first enemy exclusive to the event and was the second enemy overall to spawn during the event. It had the same speed as the [[Slow]] but had slightly more health than it.

==Appearance==
The '''Knight''' had green skin, ash grey torso and grey legs. It wore a grey rusty helmet which covers most of its facial features apart from its eyes. It had a drooling zombie face.

==Strategy==
*This is relatively easy to defeat with a couple of [[Minigunner]]s.
**However, later on during the game, to save time fighting these [[enemies]], splash damage towers, such as the [[Demoman]] and [[Rocketeer|Rocketer]], are recommended.

==Trivia==
*As this was the second [[Enemies|enemy]] to appear in the [[SFOTH Event]], and the first enemy to appear was the [[Slow]], this was the first event enemy to be encountered in the game.
*The helmet used by the '''Knight''' is a re-textured version of the {{RLinkC|8570755|Knight Helmet}} accessory in the Roblox catalog.
